title: Most Large Mammals Never Became Domestic
hook: Humanity's animal toolkit stopped expanding thousands of years ago.
closing: Modern farming still depends on an animal roster chosen deep in human history.
question: Which wild animal would you domesticate?

segments.say: Dogs were domesticated 15,000 years ago. The long human partnership with large animals began with a companion.
Only 14 candidate mammals were domesticated. Most large wild species never fit human farming.
The domesticated total reached 13 species long ago. Almost the entire modern roster was already established.
